_comment: The compiler pin: clang 4.0.1 + `-mllvm -pre-RA-sched=source` (see AGENTS.md, 'Compiler pin revision: clang 4.0.1'). 4.0.1 reproduces the reference instruction selection that 5.0.1 structurally cannot — BFC for a BIC-encodable bitfield clear, predication of a small if-block, and the original load/zero scheduling — and re-gates the matched corpus to 2,354/2,376 (99.1%). The 22 residuals are 4.0.1-vs-reference if-conversion/scheduling differences (6 of which clang 5.0.1 happens to solve; those are a per-function note, not a reason to keep 5.0.1 as the default). -mfpu=neon-fp-armv8 (the Cortex-A57 AArch32 feature set): the original .text provably contains ARMv8-A FP and NEON instructions that -mfpu=vfpv4-d16 cannot emit. -mfloat-abi=hard: the original crosses the ABI with floats in the VFP s-registers (hardfp), not integer r0-r3. The -isystem entries add libc++ (shipped with this clang at <CLANG_HOME>/include/c++/v1) layered on picolibc's C headers; -D_LIBCPP_HAS_NO_THREADS is required because the bare-metal target has no thread API. Headers and that define do not change generated code. One source of truth, consumed by tools/ledger/bytegate.py and tools/build/gen_compile_db.py.
